_shape._owner: Agency (Webbersaurus). The Change Portal NEVER writes this file - it only writes clients/168-york.json, which it overwrites wholesale on every specials publish. Keeping events and flyers here is what stops a weekly publish from clobbering them.
_shape._image_urls: Use RELATIVE /media/... paths, not absolute ones. The site is moving from 168-york-street-cafe.webbalog.com to 168yorkstcafe.com; a relative path follows the site to the new domain, an absolute one would keep pointing at the old hostname and make every flyer a cross-domain request. Append ?w=800 - webbalog resizes and converts to WebP on the fly, which turns a 2.5MB JPEG into ~330KB.

images._note: Keys are day labels and must match site.data/weekly exactly: Every Day, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
